functions.purpose: Builds, for the given player/league context, a sorted list of CLeagueSchedule records matching the context's league id (obj+0x10) into obj+0x18..+0x1c, then collects matching CLeagueScoreInfo records (whose +0x14 equals obj+0x10) into obj+0x28..+0x2c.
formulas: schedule match: record[5] == *(ctx+0x10) (league id) -> pushed to vector at ctx+0x1c (grows by 4)
sort: heapsort/introsort via FUN_118412f0/FUN_11841250/FUN_118418b0 with comparator FUN_11843a60; threshold 0x10 (16) elements switches sort strategy; depth = 2*floor(log2(n))
post-sort: for each pair (stride from +0x18), FUN_10a1a330(scheduleRec+0x50)
score match: record+0x14 == *(ctx+0x10) -> pushed to vector at ctx+0x28
functions.serverRelevance: client-only (query/sort of shared league config for display); actual standings server-authoritative
functions.notes: ctx+0x10 = league id key; uses a temporary red-black tree (puStack_30) to dedupe schedule entries by record[6] before inserting. Sort threshold 16 = insertion-sort cutoff.
